fields.description: If checked, apply late coming rules (Shift Management) — the legacy automatic point-deduction system. Otherwise, use standard attendance logic. NOTE: as of Aug 2026 policy, this is being superseded by the Short Leave Application system below; leave unchecked on new setups.
fields.label: Use Late Coming Rules (Legacy)

fields.description: Calendar days from the leave/request end date. Employee can create backdated Leave or OD/WFH only if to_date is within this many days before today. Does not apply to approval — HOD / Super HOD can approve anytime. HR can override. Default 3.
fields.label: Backdated Creation Window (Days)

fields.description: Working days (holidays and week offs excluded). Applies only to backdated Leave and OD/WFH: up to this value needs only HOD; more also needs Super HOD. Future / same-day requests need only HOD regardless of length. Default 3.
fields.label: Super HOD After Working Days

fields.description: Maximum duration allowed for a single Short Leave Application. Requests longer than this are blocked and must instead be applied as Half Day / Full Day Leave.
fields.label: Max Duration Per Short Leave (Hours)

fields.description: Maximum number of Personal Short Leaves an employee can apply for in a calendar month.
fields.label: Personal Short Leave — Monthly Cap

fields.description: Maximum number of Official Short Leaves per calendar month. Set to 0 for unlimited (current policy: unlimited).
fields.label: Official Short Leave — Monthly Cap (0 = Unlimited)
